message.content: {"turns": [{"speaker": "adjuster", "text": "Alright, this is the inspection at 118 Larkspur Court. I met with Renata Okonkwo, the insured, and she was present the whole time along with her contractor Devin Hollis. She confirmed there is a mortgage on the property through Cascade Trust Bank. The date of loss was the hail storm that came through on the fourteenth of June. The roof is architectural asphalt shingle and I found hail bruising across the south and west slopes, roughly eleven hits in a ten by ten square, and the drip edge on the west rake is dented. The policy was in force on the date of loss so this is storm related and covered. One thing worth noting, the gutters were replaced two years ago so that damage is pre-existing and not part of this claim."}], "contested_passages": ["Renata Okonkwo"]}
